text: pavasva vṛṣṭimā su no 'pāmūrmiṃ divaspari . ayakṣmā bṛhatīriṣaḥ
tayā pavasva dhārayā yayā gāva ihāgaman . janyāsa upa no gṛham
ghṛtaṃ pavasva dhārayā yajñeṣu devavītamaḥ . asmabhyaṃ vṛṣṭimā pava
sa na ūrje vyā3vyayaṃ pavitraṃ dhāva dhārayā . devāsaḥ śṛṇavanhi kam
pavamāno asiṣyadadrakṣāṃsyapajaṅghanat . pratnavadrocayanrucaḥ
araṅgamāya jagmaye 'paścādadhvane naraḥ
emenaṃ pratyetana somebhiḥ somapātamam . amatrebhirṛjīṣiṇamindraṃ sutebhirindubhiḥ
yadī sutebhirindubhiḥ somebhiḥ pratibhūṣatha . vedā viśvasya medhiro dhṛṣattantamideṣate
asmāasmā idandhaso 'dhvaryo pra bharā sutam . kuvitsamasya jenyasya śardhato 'bhiśasteravasvarat
apa śvānamarādhasaṃ hatā makhaṃ na bhṛgavaḥ somāya gāthamarcata
ā jāmiratke avyata bhuje na putra oṇyoḥ . sarajjāro na yoṣaṇāṃ varo na yonimāsadam hastacyutebhiradribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ punītana . madhāvā dhāvatā madhu
sa vīro dakṣasādhano vi yastastambha rodasī . hariḥ pavitre avyata vedhā na yonimāsadam namasedupa sīdata dadhnedabhi śrīṇītana . indumindre dadhātana
amitrahā vicarṣaṇiḥ pavasva soma śaṃ gave . devebhyo anukāmakṛt
indrāya soma pātave madāya pari ṣicyase . manaścinmanasaspatiḥ
pavamāna suvīryaṃ rayiṃ soma rirīhi naḥ . indavindreṇa no yujā
yudhedāpitvamicchase astārameṣi sūrya
na kī revantaṃ sakhyāya vindase pīyanti te surāśvaḥ . yadā kṛṇoṣi nadanuṃ samūhasyāditpiteva hūyase nava yo navatiṃ puro bibheda bāhvojasā . ahiṃ ca vṛtrahāvadhīt
sa na indraḥ śivaḥ sakhāśvāvadgomadyavamat . urudhāreva dohate
brahmayujo haraya indra keśino vahantu somapītaye vātajūto yo abhirakṣati tmanā prajāḥ piparti bahudhā vi rājati

ā tvā rathe hiraṇyaye harī mayūraśepyā . śitipṛṣṭhā vahatāṃ madhvo andhaso vivakṣaṇasya pītaye vibhrāḍ bṛhatsubhṛtaṃ vājasātamaṃ dharmaṃ divo dharuṇe satyamarpitam . amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhantamaṃ jyotirjajñe asurahā sapatnahā

pibā tvā3sya girvaṇaḥ sutasya pūrvapā iva . pariṣkṛtasya rasina iyamāsutiścārurmadāya patyate idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiruttamaṃ viśvajiddhanajiducyate bṛhat . viśvabhrāḍ bhrājo mahi sūryo dṛśa uru paprathe saha ojo acyutam
vanaprakṣamudaprutam śikṣā ṇo asminpuruhūta yāmani jīva jyotiraśīmahi

sahasradhāraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ payoduhaṃ priyaṃ devāya janmane . ṛtena ya ṛtajāto vivāvṛdhe rājā deva ṛtaṃ bṛhat mā no ajñātā vṛjanā durādhyo3 māśivāso 'va kramuḥ . tvayā vayaṃ pravataḥ śaśvatīrapo 'ti śūra tarāmasi
samiddhaḥ śukra āhutaḥ viśvā ca no jaritR^īntsatpate ahā divā naktaṃ ca rakṣiṣaḥ
garbhe mātuḥ pituṣpitā vididyutāno akṣare . sīdannṛtasya yonimā prabhaṅgī śūro maghavā tuvīmaghaḥ sammiślo viryāya kam . ubhā te bāhū vṛṣaṇā śatakrato ni yā vajraṃ mimikṣatuḥ
brahma prajāvadā bhara jātavedo vicarṣaṇe . agne yaddīdayaddivi
sutaḥ pavitraṃ paryeti rebhanmiteva sadma paśumanti hotā sarasvantaṃ havāmahe
bhadrā vastrā samanyā ' '3 vasāno mahānkavirnivacanāni śaṃsan . ā vacyasva camvoḥ pūyamāno vicakṣaṇo jāgṛvirdevavītau
samu priyo mṛjyate sāno avye yaśastaro yaśasāṃ kṣaito asme . abhi svara dhanvā pūyamāno yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
śuddhairukthairvāvṛdhvāṃsaṃ śuddhairāśīrvānmamattu sarasvatī stomyā bhūt
indra śuddho na ā gahi śuddhaḥ śuddhābhirūtibhiḥ . śuddho rayiṃ ni dhāraya śuddho mamaddhi somya
indra śuddho hi no rayiṃ śuddho ratnāni dāśuṣe . śuddho vṛtrāṇi jighnase śuddho vājaṃ siṣāsasi
devasya draviṇasyavaḥ dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt
agnirjuṣata no giro hotā yo mānuṣeṣvā . sa yakṣaddaivyaṃ janam somānāṃ svaraṇaṃ kṛṇuhi brahmaṇaspate . kakṣīvantaṃ ya auśijaḥ
tvamagne saprathā asi juṣṭo hotā vareṇyaḥ . tvayā yajñaṃ vi tanvate agna āyūṃṣi pavase ā suvorjaṃ iṣaṃ ca naḥ . āre bādhasva ducchunām
vanā vasāno varuṇo na sindhūrvi ratnadhā dayate vāryāṇi mahi vā kṣatraṃ deveṣu
śūragrāmaḥ sarvavīraḥ sahāvānjetā pavasva sanitā dhanāni . tigmāyudhaḥ kṣipradhanvā samatsvaṣāḍhaḥ sāhvānpṛtanāsu śatrūn ṛtamṛtena sapanteṣiraṃ dakṣamāśāte . adruhā devau vardhete
urugavyūtirabhayāni kṛṇvantsamīcīne ā pavasvā purandhī . apaḥ siṣāsannuṣasaḥ svā3rgāḥ saṃ cikrado maho asmabhyaṃ vājān vṛṣṭidyāvā rītyāpeṣaspatī dānumatyāḥ . bṛhantaṃ garttamāśāte
tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi haṃsyapratīnyeka itpurvanuttaścarṣaṇīdhṛtiḥ rocante rocanā divi
tamu tvā nūnamasura pracetasaṃ rādho bhāgamivemahe . mahīva kṛttiḥ śaraṇā ta indra pra te sumnā no aśnavan yuñjantyasya kāmyā harī vipakṣasā rathe . śoṇā dhṛṣṇū nṛvāhasā
ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketave peśo maryā apeśase . samuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ
asya yajñasya sukratum tvaṃ ha yaṃ cakṛṣe tvaṃ vavṛṣa induṃ madāya yujyāya somam

apāṃ napātaṃ subhagaṃ sudīditimagnimu śreṣṭhaśociṣam . sa no mitrasya varuṇasya so apāmā sumnaṃ yakṣate divi sa īṃ ratho na bhuriṣāḍayoji mahaḥ purūṇi sātaye vasūni . ādīṃ viśvā nahuṣyāṇi jātā svarṣātā vana ūrdhvā navanta
śuṣmī śardho na mārutaṃ pavasvānabhiśastā divyā yathā viṭ . āpo na makṣū sumatirbhavā naḥ sahasrāpsāḥ pṛtanāṣāṇna yajñaḥ
sa yantā śaśvatīriṣaḥ devebhirmānuṣe jane
na kirasya sahantya paryetā kayasya cit . vājo asti śravāyyaḥ sa no mandrābhiradhvare jihvābhiryajā mahaḥ . ā devānvakṣi yakṣi ca
sa vājaṃ viśvacarṣaṇirarvadbhirastu tarutā . viprebhirastu sanitā vetthā hi vedho adhvanaḥ pathaśca devāñjasā . agne yajñeṣu sukrato
hariḥ paryadravajjāḥ sūryasya droṇaḥ nanakṣe atyo na vājī vidathāni pracodayan
saṃ mātṛbhirna śiśurvāvaśāno vṛṣā dadhanve puruvāro adbhiḥ . maryo na yoṣāmabhi niṣkṛtaṃ yantsaṃ gacchate kalaśa usriyābhiḥ vājī vājeṣu dhīyate 'dhvareṣu pra ṇīyate . vipro yajñasya sādhanaḥ
uta pra pipya ūdharaghnyāyā indurdhārābhiḥ sacate sumedhāḥ . mūrdhānaṃ gāvaḥ payasā camūṣvabhi śrīṇanti vasubhirna niktaiḥ dhiyā cakre vareṇyo bhūtānāṃ garbhamā dadhe . dakṣasya pitaraṃ tanā
āpirno bodhi sadhamādye vṛdhe3 'smāṃ avantu te dhiyaḥ bhūyāma te sumatau vājino vayaṃ mā na starabhimātaye . asmāṃ citrābhiravatādabhiṣṭibhirā naḥ sumneṣu yāmaya
rasā dadhīta vṛṣabham
te jānata svamokyā3ṃ saṃ vatsāso na mātṛbhiḥ . mitho nasanta jāmibhiḥ
upa srakveṣu bapsataḥ kṛṇvate dharuṇaṃ divi . indre agnā namaḥ svaḥ
catvāryanyā bhuvanāni nirṇije cārūṇi cakre yadṛtairavardhata sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūnanu yaṃ viśve madantyūmāḥ

sa bhakṣamāṇo amṛtasya cāruṇa ubhe dyāvā kāvyenā vi śaśrathe . tejiṣṭhā apo maṃhanā pari vyata yadī devasya śravasā sado viduḥ vāvṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūryojāḥ śatrurdāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti . avyanacca vyanacca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu

te asya santu ketavo 'mṛtyavo 'dābhyāso januṣī ubhe anu . yebhirnṛmṇā ca devyā ca punata ādidrājānaṃ mananā agṛbhṇata tve kratumapi vṛñjanti viśve dviryadete trirbhavantyūmāḥ . svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā samadaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ
abhī naraṃ dhījavanaṃ ratheṣṭhāmabhīndraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vajrabāhum sa īṃ mamāda mahi karma kartave mahāmuruṃ sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satya induḥ satyamindram

abhi vastrā suvasanānyarṣābhi dhenūḥ sudughāḥ pūyamānaḥ . abhi candrā bharttave no hiraṇyābhyaśvānrathino deva soma sākaṃ jātaḥ kratunā sākamojasā vavakṣitha sākaṃ vṛddho vīryaiḥ sāsahirmṛdho vicarṣaṇiḥ . dātā rādha stuvate kāmyaṃ vasu pracetana sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satya induḥ satyamindram

abhī no arṣa divyā vasūnyabhi viśvā pārthivā pūyamānaḥ . abhi yena draviṇamaśnavāmābhyārṣeyaṃ jamadagnivannaḥ adha tviṣīmāṃ abhyojasā kṛviṃ yudhābhavadā rodasī apṛṇadasya majmanā pra vāvṛdhe . adhattānyaṃ jaṭhare premaricyata pra cetaya sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satya induḥ satyamindram
tatpṛthivīmaprathayastadastabhnā uto divam
tatte yajño ajāyata tadarka uta haskṛtiḥ . tadviśvamabhibhūrasi yajjātaṃ yacca jantvam
āmāsu pakvamairaya ā sūryaṃ rohayo divi . gharmaṃ na sāmaṃ tapatā suvṛktibhirjuṣṭaṃ girvaṇase bṛhat
vṛṣā te vṛṣṇa indurvājī sahasrasātamaḥ
ā naste gantu matsaro vṛṣā mado vareṇyaḥ . sahāvāṃ indra sānasiḥ pṛtanaṣāḍamartyaḥ
tvaṃ hi śūraḥ sanitā codayo manuṣo ratham . sahāvāndasyumavratamoṣaḥ pātraṃ na śociṣā
